# Funnels That Print

> Funnels That Print (FTP) is a direct-response funnel engineering, CRM automation, and AI calling agency founded in 2019. The agency designs high-converting customer journeys that turn cold traffic into qualified booked sales appointments and revenue on autopilot.

## Quick Facts & Verified Track Record
- **Primary Website**: https://www.funnelsthatprint.com
- **Founded**: 2019 (6+ years active experience)
- **$1.52M Case Study**: Scaled cold B2B traffic to $1,520,000 in 19 months using a turnkey VSL funnel, CAPI attribution, and automated qualification filters.
- **$847K Case Study**: Generated $847,307 collected from a low-ticket self-liquidating front door offer and backend upsell engine.
- **275+ Documented Client Proofs**: Across high-ticket consulting, home services, healthcare/medspa, mortgage, legal, and DTC eCommerce.
- **Delivery Timeline**: 5 to 10 business days for turnkey funnel builds.
- **Contact & Inquiries**: info@funnelsthatprint.com

## Core Services
- **Turnkey Funnel & Landing Page Builds**: High-ticket VSL funnels, bridge funnels, application funnels, multi-step checkout pages, and low-ticket SLO funnels.
- **CRM Automation & Multi-Touch Follow-Up**: Automated email and SMS sequences, instant lead speed-to-lead nurturing, appointment reminders, no-show winback flows, and CRM pipeline tracking.
- **24/7 AI Voice Calling Agents**: Conversational AI voice systems that autonomously call and qualify inbound leads within 60 seconds, handle objections, and book qualified meetings on calendar.
- **Attribution & Server-Side Tracking**: Full-stack tracking setups including Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, and server-side tagging.

## Glossary
- [What is a sales funnel? Definition and examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/sales-funnel): What is a sales funnel? A plain definition, the stages from ad to sale, real examples from $1.52M and $847K funnels, and the mistakes that leak revenue.
- [Tripwire offer: definition, pricing and real examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/tripwire-offer): A tripwire offer is a low-priced first purchase that turns leads into buyers. Definition, pricing, a real $27 example and the mistakes that kill margin.
- [Self-liquidating offer: definition, formula and example](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/self-liquidating-offer): A self-liquidating offer is a front-end funnel whose sales cover its ad spend. Definition, the break-even formula and a real 112% day-zero example.
- [Order bump: definition, pricing and examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/order-bump): An order bump is a one-click add-on on the checkout page. Definition, how to price it, a real $17 bump on a $27 product, and the mistakes to avoid.
- [Upsell vs downsell: definitions and examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/upsell-and-downsell): Upsell vs downsell explained: what each one is, where they sit in a funnel, real low-ticket examples and the mistakes that cost you average order value.
- [What is a VSL? Video sales letter definition and examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/vsl): What is a VSL? A video sales letter defined: how it works, the script structure, a real $1.52M VSL funnel example and the mistakes that lower bookings.
- [Lead magnet: definition, types and examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/lead-magnet): A lead magnet is a free resource traded for contact details. Definition, the types that convert best, real cost-per-lead examples and common mistakes.
- [What is speed to lead? Definition and benchmarks](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/speed-to-lead): What is speed to lead? The time from form fill to first contact. Definition, how to measure it, our 38-second median across 60+ deployments, and mistakes.
- [Show rate: definition, formula and how to improve it](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/show-rate): Show rate is the share of booked calls that happen. The formula, what counts as good, how 3-channel reminders reach up to 88%, and mistakes to avoid.
- [What is Conversions API? Definition and how it works](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/conversions-api): What is Conversions API? Meta's server-side tracking explained: how it works with the Pixel, which events to send, deduplication, and a 31% event lift.
- [Meta Pixel: what it is and how it tracks your funnel](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/meta-pixel): The Meta Pixel is browser code that reports funnel events to Meta. Definition, standard events, how it pairs with Conversions API, and setup mistakes.
- [CRM pipeline: definition, stages and examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/crm-pipeline): A CRM pipeline tracks every lead from new to won. Definition, stages for a booked-call funnel, conversion math between stages, and the mistakes to avoid.
- [What is an AI voice agent? Definition and examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/ai-voice-agent): What is an AI voice agent? Software that calls, qualifies and books leads by phone. How it works, real costs per booking, and the mistakes to avoid.
- [GoHighLevel snapshot: definition and how agencies use it](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/gohighlevel-snapshot): A GoHighLevel snapshot copies a full account setup into a new sub-account. What it includes, how agencies use it, a real example and common mistakes.
- [What is cost per lead? Formula, benchmarks and examples](https://www.funnelsthatprint.com/glossary/cost-per-lead): What is cost per lead? The CPL formula, real benchmarks from $4.27 roofing leads to $24 at volume, and why the cheapest lead is not always the best lead.
